concept.zh: 给策略规定动作优先级
concept.en: Give a strategy an action priority

brief.zh: 实现 choose_part_action(player, part, blocked)。如果已经在零件格，返回 "pick"。否则先试向着目标水平移动，再试竖直方向。跳过 blocked 中的方向，两种都走不了就返回 "wait"。
brief.en: Implement choose_part_action(player, part, blocked). If you are on the part, return "pick". Otherwise try moving toward the target horizontally, then vertically. Skip directions in blocked. If neither works, return "wait".

hints.zh: 坐标是 [x, y]，x 越大越往右，y 越大越往下。用 "right" not in blocked 判断右边可用。
hints.en: Coordinates use [x, y]. Larger x is farther right and larger y is farther down. Use "right" not in blocked to check whether moving right is allowed.

snippets.code:
if part[0] > player[0] and "right" not in blocked:
        return "right"

if part[1] > player[1] and "down" not in blocked:
        return "down"
